name: confluence-forge-app
description: Option 3 (Confluence half): a Forge Custom UI macro that reads the budget .xlsx already attached to the page, renders it as an interactive plan in place, and writes a new version back as an attachment — no download/re-upload round trip. Sibling to ../browser-converter (option 1) and ../office-addin (option 2); reuses their app rendering approach and vendored libraries.
